policy.gearAcquisition: distinct signature-crafted canonical item only; never convert chest/drop-exclusive equipment into craftables
policy.identity: one predetermined combat trait per item, plus authored look; normal rarity/quality/affix rolls retained, never double-scale trait
policy.craftCost: start from original same-slot role/tier foundation recipe; keep common/scarce combat inputs and binder, multiply only refined resource inputs by roughly 1.25 (ceil), spend one source-exclusive catalyst, suggested Gold x1.5, duration x1.25, equipment XP unchanged; exact recipe not executable and must be priced after final economy approval

trade.fishingMaterial: proposed tradeable only after Market escrow integration; no direct purchase from NPC shop
trade.fishingSignatureGear: proposed tradeable only after exact-instance escrow approvals
trade.dungeonMaterial: account_bound, no guild/dungeon shop, no Expedition Marks exchange, no market trade, no mail or bank loophole
trade.dungeonSignatureGear: account_bound, cannot enter Player Market; account ownership validated before equip/Bank access
trade.earnedExclusiveGear: dungeon/party/world boss chest exclusive gear still reward-only and never craftable

policy.frequency: no guaranteed special fish or dungeon material; one server-authoritative roll per eligible catch/settled dungeon completion; duplicates do not reroll on receipt retry
policy.concurrency: same account-wide receipt and item ownership lineage; no character-switch dupes; existing 12-run/weekly marks entitlement must not be used as automatic material drop guarantee
policy.failedDungeon: no rare completion material; a dungeon boss entry, failed run, app close, or repeat receipt cannot grant material
policy.rareBlueprints: existing six elite/boss blueprint items remain separate: fishing and dungeon components alone cannot unlock blueprint-only recipes

combatContract.stackWithExistingRareBlueprints: proposed count toward same two-trait family budget; no stacking duplicate traits or multiple identical triggers
combatContract.trigger: server-authored deterministic event with domain-separated randomness; never client declared or generated on replay
combatContract.healingAndShieldEvents: count actual positive heal/shield applied, not self-casts with zero effect

bleed.applicable: direct damaging physical hit; no reflective damage, DoT ticks, pet echo or multi-hit duplicate rolls
bleed.scalesFrom: eligible post-mitigation direct hit; quality/rarity and affixes already folded into that hit once
bleed.stacking: one same-source bleed per attacker per target; refresh but never stack; strongest remaining contribution retained
bleed.bossRule: 50% damage coefficient versus bosses, total damage over 4 seconds; immune bosses receive no proc
bleed.deterministicPacing: cooldown advanced by server encounter time, not device clock

mitigation.scope: incoming enemy direct non-true damage only; applied multiplicatively after armor/ward

releaseBlockers: confirm final Combat 2.0 proc and buff scheduler, threat/DoT normalization and server HMAC
mixed Effect Gem and set bonus rules
server-authenticated dungeon reward receipts and retries
fishing side-drop eligibility and tool boosts
exact-craft ownership/Market escrow and bind flags
